facts: Sump pump stopped and pit overflowed into basement during a power outage lasting from 02:00 to 18:30 on 12-22, a total of 16.5 hours.
Battery backup unit ran down during the outage; pump tested fine after power returned.
No indication that the failed pump component was retained for inspection.
note: The loss involves water backup from a sump pump during a power outage exceeding 12 continuous hours, which triggers the exception that prevents exclusion E-51 from applying [HO-0820_05-24#05]. The endorsement defines water backup and provides coverage up to $10,000 per event with a $1,000 deductible [HO-0820_05-24#02][HO-0820_05-24#03]. The insured’s duty to retain the failed component is noted but not confirmed in the facts [HO-0304_03-24#06].
